The Cursed One#364.src: A- ag- again?! No, we should do the z- z- zipline first. I don't want you th- thr- throwing up all over me.
The Cursed One#364.dst: ¡¿O- o- otra vez?! No, primero la t- t- tirolina. No quiero que me v- vo- vomites encima.
The Cursed One#364.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#366.src: You kn- know I'm right! Oh, uh, {u}, you can j- j- join us if you want! It's fun, I pr- promise.
The Cursed One#366.dst: ¡S- sabes que tengo razón! Ah, {u}, ¡p- p- puedes venir si quieres! Es divertido, te lo pr- prometo.
The Cursed One#366.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#368.src: The {p} orchestra is definitely the best in all of Fruma! Well, not that I've heard any other orchestras.
The Cursed One#368.dst: ¡La orquesta de {p} es sin duda la mejor de toda Fruma! Bueno, tampoco es que haya oído otras orquestas.
The Cursed One#368.speaker: Festival Goer

The Cursed One#369.src: Aha! Hello there, {u}! Enjoying our festival, are you?
The Cursed One#369.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#370.src: I trust you and Zeph have acquired all the necessary materials in the time since we last spoke?
The Cursed One#370.dst: ¿Zeph y tú habéis conseguido ya todos los materiales necesarios desde la última vez?
The Cursed One#370.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#371.src: As soon as the festival concludes, I shall get right to smithing. I have a good feeling about this one!
The Cursed One#371.dst: En cuanto acabe el festival, me pondré a forjar de inmediato. ¡Tengo un buen presentimiento con esta!
The Cursed One#371.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#372.src: I, ah... am still learning. But I have greatly improved since I started, worry not!
The Cursed One#372.dst: Yo, ah... aún estoy aprendiendo. Pero he mejorado muchísimo desde que empecé, ¡descuida!
The Cursed One#372.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#373.src: ...ehm. I suppose I should return to my report...
The Cursed One#373.dst: ...ejem. Supongo que debería volver a mi informe...
The Cursed One#373.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#374.src: Hm? Ah, yes, I forget this is your first year. First week, even.
The Cursed One#374.dst: ¿Hm? Ah, sí, olvido que es tu primer año. Tu primera semana, incluso.
The Cursed One#374.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#375.src: I am... gathering data. Recording the changes since last year's festival guard positioning and numbers, types of stands, amount of attendees and so on.
The Cursed One#375.dst: Estoy... reuniendo datos. Anoto los cambios desde el festival del año pasado: posición y número de guardias, tipos de puestos, cantidad de asistentes y demás.
The Cursed One#375.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#376.src: It is... perhaps unnecessarily thorough. Much of this data has not proven to be useful thus far... but it is something for me to do, and I do it well.
The Cursed One#376.dst: Es... quizá innecesariamente minucioso. Gran parte de estos datos no ha servido de nada hasta ahora... pero es algo que puedo hacer, y lo hago bien.
The Cursed One#376.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#377.src: These festivals... I suppose our discomfort is something Syndra and I share. It can be hard for us to enjoy ourselves, knowing what we do.
The Cursed One#377.dst: Estos festivales... supongo que esa incomodidad la compartimos Syndra y yo. Nos cuesta disfrutar, sabiendo lo que sabemos.
The Cursed One#377.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#378.src: I am grateful that the younger Leaves can still find joy here. Perhaps you might as well, given your... relative lack of history.
The Cursed One#378.dst: Agradezco que las Hojas más jóvenes aún encuentren alegría aquí. Quizá tú también puedas, dada tu... relativa falta de historia.
The Cursed One#378.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#379.src: Ah, but I am rambling. If you will excuse me, I need to get back to... counting all the new food items... hm.
The Cursed One#379.dst: Ah, pero divago. Si me disculpas, debo volver a... contar todos los platos nuevos... hm.
The Cursed One#379.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#380.src: Welcome. Can I interest you in buying anything?
The Cursed One#380.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#381.src: Perhaps you would like to hear what we have to offer?
The Cursed One#381.dst: ¿Quizá le gustaría oír lo que ofrecemos?
The Cursed One#381.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#383.src: We are selling both the raw ingredients and some freshly brewed tea.
The Cursed One#383.dst: Vendemos tanto los ingredientes en crudo como té recién hecho.
The Cursed One#383.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#384.src: Let me bring you on a history lesson to learn about the finest ingredients the forest has to offer.
The Cursed One#384.dst: Permítame darle una lección de historia sobre los mejores ingredientes que ofrece el bosque.
The Cursed One#384.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#385.src: Tea is very popular in Auburn and the people have managed to make tea out of almost any plant you can find! Some are... more tasty than others.
The Cursed One#385.dst: En Auburn el té es muy popular, ¡y la gente ha logrado hacer té con casi cualquier planta que encuentre! Algunos son... más sabrosos que otros.
The Cursed One#385.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#386.src: The Reishi Mushroom for example! Brewing tea of the mushroom alone often turns... bitter. With the help of herbs and spices it goes from a bitter to a rich spicy flavour!
The Cursed One#386.dst: ¡La seta reishi, por ejemplo! Preparar té solo con la seta suele salir... amargo. Con ayuda de hierbas y especias, ¡el amargor se convierte en un sabor rico y especiado!
The Cursed One#386.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#387.src: The mushroom itself is said to keep you healthy. It is also said to boost your resistances!
The Cursed One#387.dst: Se dice que la seta en sí te mantiene sano. ¡También dicen que aumenta tus resistencias!
The Cursed One#387.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#388.src: The Tea Tree Mushroom on the other hand is perfect for a good tea blend. The mushroom alone gives it a sweet and earthy flavour.
The Cursed One#388.dst: La seta del árbol del té, en cambio, es perfecta para una buena mezcla. Ella sola aporta un sabor dulce y terroso.
The Cursed One#388.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#389.src: The mushroom is also said to regenerate you back to health and alleviate the feeling of tiredness! How amazing.
The Cursed One#389.dst: ¡También dicen que esta seta te devuelve la salud y alivia la sensación de cansancio! Qué maravilla.
The Cursed One#389.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#390.src: If you feel like buying something, please talk to my assistant.
The Cursed One#390.dst: Si le apetece comprar algo, hable con mi ayudante, por favor.
The Cursed One#390.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#393.src: It's festival time! *hic* that means... drinking time!!!
The Cursed One#393.dst: ¡Es hora de festival! *hip* o sea que... ¡¡¡hora de beber!!!
The Cursed One#393.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#394.src: Inteeeerested in any of our mouth-watering beverages?
The Cursed One#394.dst: ¿Te inteeeeresa alguna de nuestras bebidas de rechupete?
The Cursed One#394.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#396.src: *Hic* Todaaaay, we have a couple of imported drinks as well as our classic Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#396.dst: *Hip* Hooooy tenemos un par de bebidas importadas y nuestro clásico Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#396.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#397.src: Seen them blue fruits in the trees around here? Most of 'em are inedible Liffberries, buuut, some of 'em are actually a more edible fruit called Autumn Fruit, which carry a high value!
The Cursed One#397.dst: ¿Has visto esos frutos azules de los árboles de por aquí? La mayoría son Liffberries incomibles, peeero algunos son en realidad un fruto más comestible llamado Autumn Fruit, ¡que vale mucho!
The Cursed One#397.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#398.src: The Amaretto is made from Autumn Fruit kernels! We have aaaalso mixed in some Liff Leaves which *hic* gives it its warm colour and slightly bitter and metallic taste.
The Cursed One#398.dst: ¡El Amaretto se hace con las pepitas del Autumn Fruit! Taaaambién le hemos mezclado hojas de Liff, que *hip* le dan ese color cálido y ese sabor algo amargo y metálico.
The Cursed One#398.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#400.src: We have also imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#400.dst: También hemos importado la famoooosa Heather Beer de las ricas Tierras Altas.
The Cursed One#400.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#401.src: A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
The Cursed One#401.dst: Una cerveza infusionada con el brezo más hermoso de las Tierras Altas. *hip* Casi se saborea la opulencia de los aristócratas.
The Cursed One#401.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#402.src: *hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
The Cursed One#402.dst: *hip* Yo en tu lugar la probaría siiin duda. Cosas así no llegan a Auburn muy a menudo.
The Cursed One#402.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#403.src: If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
The Cursed One#403.dst: Si te apetece bendecir tus papilas, habla con mi hermano de ahí. *hip*
The Cursed One#403.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#406.src: We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
The Cursed One#406.dst: Tenemos productos de la zona recién cocinados y horneados.
The Cursed One#406.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#407.src: Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
The Cursed One#407.dst: ¿Quieres que te cuente nuestro menú, cielo?
The Cursed One#407.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#408.src: Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
The Cursed One#408.dst: ¡Perfecto! ¡Auburn es famosa por sus sabores intensos, terrosos y acogedores!
The Cursed One#408.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#409.src: We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
The Cursed One#409.dst: También nos encanta cocinar con nuestros animales salvajes y recursos, pero seguro que ya lo sabes todo, jaja.
The Cursed One#409.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#410.src: Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
The Cursed One#410.dst: Déjame repasar algunos de los platos especiales de hoy, cielo.
The Cursed One#410.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#411.src: The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
The Cursed One#411.dst: El plato más importante de Auburn es, por supuesto, el "Regalo del Bosque". Una mezcla maravillosa de carne y fruta envuelta en una hoja al vapor.
The Cursed One#411.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#412.src: We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
The Cursed One#412.dst: Esta mañana envolvimos a mano todos los regalos, ¡y salen al vapor para llevar!
The Cursed One#412.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#413.src: If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
The Cursed One#413.dst: Si eso no te interesa, también tenemos el clásico "Festín del Bosque". Un trozo de carne de jabalí a la parrilla con ensalada de mudkin.
The Cursed One#413.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#414.src: I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
The Cursed One#414.dst: Me temo que ahora nos hemos quedado sin ingredientes. ¡Vuelve más tarde!
The Cursed One#414.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#416.src: Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
The Cursed One#416.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#417.src: I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
The Cursed One#417.dst: Me alegra que hayas decidido ver mi pequeña exposición.
The Cursed One#417.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#418.src: Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps want to hear some fun facts about our animals?
The Cursed One#418.dst: ¿Es tu primera vez por esta parte de la región? ¿Te apetece oír algunas curiosidades sobre nuestros animales?
The Cursed One#418.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#420.src: First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
The Cursed One#420.dst: ¡Primero tenemos nuestros bichos Roly! Estos pequeñajos son una plaga para la gente de aquí.
The Cursed One#420.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#421.src: They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
The Cursed One#421.dst: Les encanta roer las casas. Por suerte, casi todo se construye sobre pilotes yyyy esos bichos no trepan.
The Cursed One#421.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#422.src: Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
The Cursed One#422.dst: ¡Y ahora! ¡Ranas! La ciénaga del noroeste es el mejor sitio para verlas. Solo ten cuidado con el monstruo de la ciénaga.
The Cursed One#422.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#423.src: Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
The Cursed One#423.dst: Las ranas pueden ser buen alimento, ¡pero preferimos verlas como... mascotas!
The Cursed One#423.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#424.src: Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#424.dst: ¡Por último, los zorros! Estos pequeñajos son muy tímidos por naturaleza. Pero cuidado, hay versiones más grandes, conocidas como Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#424.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#425.src: Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
The Cursed One#425.dst: Esos no son tan tímidos... ni tan pacíficos como sus primos pequeños. ¡Pero son igual de monos!
The Cursed One#425.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#426.src: Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
The Cursed One#426.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#428.src: Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
The Cursed One#428.dst: ¡Güenas! Esto es una granja de Mudkin.
The Cursed One#428.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#429.src: Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
The Cursed One#429.dst: Los Mudkin son una verdura mu popular en la comida de por aquí. Crecen bajo tierra, ¡y hay que sacarlos de un tirón!
The Cursed One#429.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#430.src: Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
The Cursed One#430.dst: ¿Te interesa una partida de Recogida de Mudkin?
The Cursed One#430.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#431.src: Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
The Cursed One#431.dst: Básicamente, tu meta es sacar todos los puntos que puedas antes de que se acabe el tiempo.
The Cursed One#431.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#432.src: There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
The Cursed One#432.dst: Hay tres tamaños de Mudkin, y cada tamaño da unos puntos. ¡Pero ojo! Hay dos raíces de jengibre que dan puntos negativos.
The Cursed One#432.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#433.src: Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
The Cursed One#433.dst: Solo tienes que hacer clic en las partículas de tierra que salgan en el campo. Hay cinco sitios pa recoger.
The Cursed One#433.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#436.src: Return to Syndra at or keep exploring the festival.
The Cursed One#436.dst: Vuelve con Syndra o sigue explorando el festival.

The Cursed One#437.src: Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
The Cursed One#437.dst: Ah. Ahí estás. ¿Te lo has pasado bien?
The Cursed One#437.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#439.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.**
The Cursed One#439.dst: Aunque el festival gire en torno a la Corona, siempre he apreciado cómo representa nuestra cultura.**
The Cursed One#439.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#440.src: I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
The Cursed One#440.dst: Espero que tu experiencia con la Corona no haya arruinado tu idea de nuestra provincia... aún hay mucho que celebrar.
The Cursed One#440.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#441.src: Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
The Cursed One#441.dst: A veces está bien dejar a un lado las penas y... tomar las cosas como son. Respirar un poco.
The Cursed One#441.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#443.src: It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
The Cursed One#443.dst: Cuesta disfrutar con lo que has vivido con la Corona pesándote, ¿verdad? Conozco esa sensación.
The Cursed One#443.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#444.src: Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
The Cursed One#444.dst: Mmn. Yo te aconsejaría aprovechar lo que puedas. Por mi experiencia, los momentos felices así son fugaces.
The Cursed One#444.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#445.src: If there's even the smallest spark of joy... take hold of it before it's gone. Cherish it while you still can. Try not to grow old and jaded like I have, would you?
The Cursed One#445.dst: Si hay aunque sea la chispa más pequeña de alegría... agárrala antes de que se apague. Valórala mientras puedas. Intenta no hacerte viejo y cínico como yo, ¿quieres?
The Cursed One#445.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#446.src: Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
The Cursed One#446.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#447.src: Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
The Cursed One#447.dst: Cada año... todos y cada uno de los años, la Corona organiza estos festivales. Empiezan aquí y van dando la vuelta a la provincia.
The Cursed One#447.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#448.src: The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
The Cursed One#448.dst: El festival es fiesta, un día de descanso, de celebración. ¡Qué regalo, no tener que trabajar un rato! Qué generosidad.
The Cursed One#448.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#449.src: I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
The Cursed One#449.dst: No soporto estar aquí... Cada año me convenzo de que podré aguantarlo. Lo que me recuerda, memorias de hace mucho. Y cada año me equivoco.
The Cursed One#449.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#450.src: ...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
The Cursed One#450.dst: ...Ah. Es la hora. El acto principal está a punto de empezar.
The Cursed One#450.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#451.src: Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
The Cursed One#451.dst: ¡El discurso anual de Su Majestad, por supuesto! No sería un Festival de la Corona si ella no apareciera, ¿verdad?
The Cursed One#451.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#452.src: Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
The Cursed One#452.dst: ¡Ja! No, no. Claro que no. No sería un Festival de la Corona sin un discurso de la propia Su Majestad, ¿verdad?
The Cursed One#452.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#453.src: Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
The Cursed One#453.dst: Ahora... observa. Contempla a nuestra enemiga, fíjate en cómo se presenta, en lo que dice y en lo que calla.
The Cursed One#453.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#454.src: Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
The Cursed One#454.dst: Ah... ¡amado pueblo de {p}! Qué alegría, qué honor es estar de nuevo entre vosotros.
The Cursed One#454.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#455.src: Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
The Cursed One#455.dst: Algunos dirán que {p}, con sus árboles en flor y sus grandiosos castillos históricos, es nuestra región más hermosa...
The Cursed One#455.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#456.src: But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
The Cursed One#456.dst: Pero yo siempre he sentido un aprecio especial por este lugar. Las hojas y sus tonos cálidos, mecidas por la brisa suave... todas las penas del mundo valdrían por esta vista.
The Cursed One#456.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#457.src: If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
The Cursed One#457.dst: ¡Si pudiera, quizá me quedaría aquí todo el año! Ah, pero ay... ¡el trabajo en la Ciudadela nos mantiene a todos ocupados!
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#458.src: We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
The Cursed One#458.dst: Tenemos muchos planes para el año que viene. Más importaciones de las otras regiones, viajes más accesibles para todos, ¡y nuevas plazas en el ejército!
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#459.src: More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
The Cursed One#459.dst: Pronto se revelará más. Ahora, unas palabras de vuestro amado Soberano.
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#460.src: ...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well- Testing, testing, one two three...
The Cursed One#460.dst: ...ah. Lo único que calculé mal. La altura del micro. En fin- Probando, probando, uno dos tres...
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#461.src: Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
The Cursed One#461.dst: ¡Bienvenidos todos! Soy vuestro Soberano, Zhiraok. Es un honor estar hoy de nuevo ante vosotros.
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#462.src: Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer this place, these people, really have become my home.
The Cursed One#462.dst: Dos décadas de trabajo en {p}. Veinte años. Se me hace mucho más largo: este lugar, esta gente, se han convertido de verdad en mi hogar.
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#463.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#463.dst: Mi deber no es solo servir a la Corona, sino también serviros a vosotros. Mejorar vuestras vidas y elevar esta región a nuevas cotas.
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#464.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#464.dst: Ya sea aumentando la producción de hojas de Liff para compartir nuestros recursos y saberes con toda la provincia, lo cual debemos a vuestro esfuerzo...
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#465.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#465.dst: ...o afinando nuestras infraestructuras para exponenciar vuestra calidad de vida, ¡en agradecimiento por lo que hacéis!
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#466.src: I'd be here all day listing the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#466.dst: Pasaría el día entero enumerando las mejoras del último año, así que resumiré: varias mejoras en carreteras principales, incontables empleos nuevos, patrullas de guardia multiplicadas para manteneros a salvo...
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#467.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#467.dst: El lugar del que partimos hace veinte años hoy es irreconocible. Mi promesa es que dentro de veinte años pueda decir lo mismo de cuánto habremos mejorado juntos nuestro hogar.
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#468.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p}- Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#468.dst: ...hasta el día en que sumemos la grandeza de {p}- ¡Gracias a todos! ¡Disfrutad de las fiestas!
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#469.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#469.dst: ¡Qué gran labor ha hecho el Soberano Zhiraok por nuestra provincia! ¡En verdad, no podría haber mejor elección para ese cargo!
The Cursed One#469.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#470.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#470.dst: {p} florece bajo su gobierno, y no podría estar más satisfecha con los avances que ha logrado.
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#471.src: One final message before we conclude. These past years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed - a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#471.dst: Un último mensaje antes de concluir. Estos últimos años hemos visto cada vez menos informes sobre los malditos - señal de nuestra fuerza como pueblo.
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#472.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#472.dst: ¡Y todo gracias a vosotros! Vuestras diligentes denuncias de actividades sospechosas son decisivas para mantener segura nuestra provincia.
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#473.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#473.dst: ¡Debemos mantenernos firmes, juntos! ¡No le concederemos la victoria a ese mal, no dejaremos caer nuestra provincia como han caído tantas más allá de nuestros muros!
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#474.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#476.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#477.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#477.dst: Así es. Resulta bastante desconcertante, ¿verdad? Es una especie de reverencia que nunca muestra en otra parte.
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#478.src: And if there's one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#478.dst: Y si hay algo en lo que estoy segura de que dice la verdad, es esto. Lo cual lo hace aún más extraño.
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#479.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#479.dst: Sí, sí... mejoras. La vida ha mejorado desde que ascendió a ese cargo. Eso se lo concedo. Se ha volcado en Auburn.
The Cursed One#479.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#480.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#480.dst: Pero sigue trabajando bajo la Corona. No lo olvides. Por cada mejora que ha hecho, hay otra que ha dejado desatendida.
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#481.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#481.dst: No, supongo que no lo dirían. Mejor que el pueblo no sepa de esos fracasos.
The Cursed One#481.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#482.dst: Pero ten por seguro que, de puertas adentro, no lo han olvidado. Seguirán buscándote.
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#483.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#483.dst: Sí... los malditos. La Corona necesita mantener al pueblo con miedo. Si hay otro enemigo ahí fuera del que la Corona supuestamente los protege...
The Cursed One#483.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#484.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#484.dst: Por algo quieren que la gente crea que el mundo exterior está destruido. Cualquier contacto podría romper la ilusión.
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#485.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#485.dst: Pronto cerrarán el festival... así que aquí hemos terminado. Deberíamos irnos antes de que la multitud se disperse y nos vean.
The Cursed One#485.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#486.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#486.dst: He convocado una reunión para mañana y me gustaría que asistieras. Trataremos los próximos pasos, ahora que la Corona ha seguido su camino. Nos vemos allí.
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#488.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#488.dst: Creo que ya me he hartado de que la gente se cuele en mi despacho. ¿Te importaría llamar la próxima vez?
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#489.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital - your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
The Cursed One#489.dst: Mmn. Así resulta más interesante. Traigo noticias de la capital - se ha aprobado tu petición de tropas adicionales. Los traslados deberían llegar a final de semana.

The Cursed One#490.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#490.dst: Bueno, eso resolverá algunos problemas. Pero ese no es todo el mensaje, ¿verdad? ¿Qué comentario obtuso me manda esta vez?
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#491.src: Merely a reminder to... "get your act together," as it were.
The Cursed One#491.dst: Solo un recordatorio de que... "te pongas las pilas", por así decirlo.

The Cursed One#492.src: Get my act toge That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#492.dst: Que me ponga las pi ¡Ese fractal a la deriva ha desarrollado menos en su cuadrante en ciento cincuenta años que yo en dos de los últimos diez!
The Cursed One#492.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#493.src: I Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#493.dst: Yo Uf, céntrate, Z... Si ni siquiera está aquí, no dejes que te saque de quicio...
The Cursed One#493.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#494.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#494.dst: Me bajo de esa tangente. Si eso fuera todo lo que tienes que decir, sería perder tu tiempo. ¿Qué tienes que decir que un mensajero no pueda mandar por carta?
The Cursed One#494.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#495.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
The Cursed One#495.dst: El intruso. ¿Tu administración cree que puede controlar la situación?

The Cursed One#496.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#496.dst: Ahí está. Escucha, ya le tengo el número, ¿vale? No hay forma de entrar ni salir del distrito sin ser detectado. Lo rastrearemos.
The Cursed One#496.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#497.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#497.dst: Aunque, a diferencia de otros, mi ego no es tan enorme como para no ver cuándo un aliado puede servir. Los tuyos sois expertos en esto, así que si pudieras prestarme un par de ojos, te lo agradecería mucho.
The Cursed One#497.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#498.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
The Cursed One#498.dst: Veré qué puedo hacer. Da la casualidad de que ya hay una operación en marcha en la zona; cuando concluya, podemos hablar de reasignar al agente.

The Cursed One#499.src: One last thing- the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
The Cursed One#499.dst: Una última cosa- ya te han dejado clara la identidad del intruso, ¿no?

The Cursed One#500.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#500.dst: Ajá. Ya te dije, le tengo el número.
The Cursed One#500.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#501.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
The Cursed One#501.dst: Entonces entenderás la orden de Su Majestad de no hablar de este asunto con el más nuevo de los nuestros. La ascensión es un proceso difícil, y sería... imprudente añadirle más distracciones.

The Cursed One#502.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#502.dst: No querríamos distraer a un trabajador tan aplicado, claro. Pero ¿eso es todo, Jefa de Espías? Mi lista de tareas crece por minutos.
The Cursed One#502.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
